BZ F-C4G3, BR/BH/BD E-C4F4, CA F-C4K6 are source-readable and retained despite A1 normal B-board entries.

Bottom P0 AC row89 drives BR 2D05 at84 on137; block PADDL row90 drives BR D09 at82 on136. BY return is131──88──89↑61, BZ return130──86──92↑82. P0 AN stem114 with diamond114,48 fans AG2/BP2; P0 AM stem90 with diamond90,34 fans AF2/BM2; P0 AA row26 fans AE2 and BV input via diamond68. AM plain secondary separately reaches AN. Return loops BU──BS, BS──BY, BV──BX, BW──CC, BX──BZ, BY──BW, BZ──CA. All crossings without printed diamonds are unjoined.
Blank corporate tag. Open diamond in SDBO ◇ PADDL INTO T. Native connector table uses A7/A6, not Q7/Q6. Original scan before/after recorded by source inventory.
Pencil diagonals and plus marks omitted; printed source marks preserved.

All diagram card and connector print was inspected on the native scan. Literal source values are retained; unmatched A1 page-index entries are reported separately from geometry validation. A1 provides no local wire ownership.
